F1.why: Specify (Standard route for R) Step 3: list assumptions, ask one round at a time, max 4 questions with recommended answers; stop rule max 3 rounds (SKILL.md:152). Runs per feature, not only at project creation.

F2.why: spec template requires AC-1..n in Given/When/Then or measurable form; spec-lint enforces before sign-off (lifecycle.md:25).

F3.why: fresh-context challenger subagent with 12-item checklist on every draft; also PM critique (lifecycle.md:25).

F4.why: change protocol: Revision log, impact analysis, Revision N+1, re-approval; approval hash voids on edit (governance.md:96-103).

F5.why: plan tasks carry Blocked by; plan-graph rejects cycles/unknown IDs and builds waves (lifecycle.md:26).

F6.why: Planner (always dispatched on Standard Design) must dispatch the Architect for every decision expensive to reverse (schema, public API, new component, cross-service contract), who writes ADRs docs/adr/NNNN (lifecycle.md:26, artifacts.md:73, ADR template artifacts.md:150-152). Same rule as F10/F26: mandatory under a stated criterion by an always-dispatched agent.

F8.why: scored size rubric (S) and 7 risk triggers (R), path = higher route (paths.md:49, SKILL.md:57-59).

F9.why: red first with pasted failing output per task; run-ledger refuses done without red event (tdd.md:14).

F10.why: debug loop entered automatically at B1 (3 failed red-green, loops.md:11); ranked falsifiable hypotheses, bound 3 refuted, root cause proven by test.

F11.why: 13 function-named agent briefs with tools, reads, never-sees; Standard activates Analyst, Planner, Developer, Test Engineer, Reviewer, SRE etc. (agents.md:39).

F12.why: one fresh Developer per task, brief with pointers and exact values only (modes.md:33); subagent is default dispatch (modes.md:11); dispatch rules agents.md:53.

F13.why: completion claim needs DoD + AC command output run after last change, bound to fingerprint; stale rows never count (verification.md:93).

F14.why: one fresh context per lens, never the Developer's reasoning; Reviewer re-runs commands (verification.md:34); per-task reviewer subagent (executing-plans/SKILL.md:116).

F18.why: No shipped runner opening a fresh session per task; unattended mode runs inside one controller session (autonomous.md:3). Only documented: one `codex exec`/`gemini -p` process per agent on hosts without subagents (platforms.md:51,53) and Cursor Background Agents (platforms.md:55). Contestable 0/1; brief rule F18=1 for documented-only.

F19.why: attended: feature branch, never commit on default branch (preflight branch check, autonomous.md:31); unattended: linked worktree created by run-ledger start (autonomous.md:23).

F20.why: append-only run ledger survives compaction/session loss; resume algorithm (resume-and-isolation.md:35-46); ledger on every executing-plans run (artifacts.md:79).

F23.why: AC-n -> plan task Tn -> commit trailer Refs: Tn AC-n -> test name contains AC-n -> PR Verification; two-way gap analysis before Test sign-off (verification.md:105).

F31.why: In-boundary: unit test suites for every gate script (skills/agentic-sdlc/scripts/test/*.test.mjs) and budget-check.mjs for skill word budgets (SKILL.md:146 'CI on skills/**', platforms.md:86), but no in-boundary CI wires them; the repo CI (.github/workflows/validate.yml:73) is outside the brief's method boundary -> lower value under the ambiguity rule.

F32.why: only a cumulative --tokens/--turns counter supplied by the agent for budgets; max_tokens off unless configured (autonomous.md:78, run-ledger.mjs:20). No measured telemetry; unattended (opt-in) context.

F33.why: spec word budget 1,500 words on Standard, enforced by spec-lint BUD01 (spec-lint.mjs:378); Developer report <= 15 lines (executing-plans/references/modes.md:38); agent briefs <= 600 words (agents.md:3); evidence excerpt <= 40 lines (verification.md:16).

F34.why: every skill ships evals.json/trigger-eval.json with expectations and a runner (skill-creator/scripts/run_eval.py), but the only recorded run is a trigger eval marked INCONCLUSIVE (docs/research/2026-11-25-eval-check.md:15); no measured behaviour result.

L5.notes: T0 inclusion set: skills/** plus root CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md (the brief's method boundary); exclude CHANGELOG.md, docs/, cli-installer/, scripts/, resources/, .github/ and all other repo files. T1: root CLAUDE.md (36 KB), AGENTS.md and GEMINI.md excluded: they are maintainer guidance for the method repo ('when working with code in this repository'); nothing in cli-installer/lib/claude.js or the plugin copies them into a user project, so Claude Code does not inject them in R. skills/*/agents/*.md are briefs inside a skill, not host-registered agents, so not preloaded. The AGENTS.md block proxy is flagged contestable. T3 rule: a file is included only when an imperative on the Standard route names it unconditionally or under a trigger R certainly fires (every stage, task, approval, completion claim, stage end; Standard-path specialist triggers PM, Test Engineer, Security Auditor via L3, Release Engineer and SRE for a production service). Excluded: all dagger (later-release, broken-reference) files; 'Full workflow: skill X' pointers without a hand-off imperative (verification-gate, test-strategy, deployment-pipeline, shipping-and-handover, operations-and-incidents, retrospective skill); failure-only or conditional loads (systematic-debugging, fix-loop-and-escalation.md, re-review prompts, receive-mode.md, parallel-tasks.md, autonomous.md, brownfield.md, UX Designer/ux.md, Architect/ADR, threat-model.md, grill-me, brainstorming); one-time project-context adopt/setup (treated as pre-feature setup, consistent with the F1 rule); first-use quickstart.md; agent 'Skills and modules' lists without a load imperative; scripts (executed, not read). Each file listed once.

notes: Route for R: Standard. R touches 5-20 files so Quick's file bound (>3 files, paths.md:86) is exceeded even at S=4; risk inputs unknown default to Standard (SKILL.md:61); 'Typical item: Story, feature' is Standard (lifecycle.md:60) and the worked example is Standard. Specify+Design combined review if plan <=5 tasks, else separate (paths.md:69). Triggers assumed firing: Product Manager (new feature on Standard), Test Engineer, Security Auditor via lens L3, Release Engineer and SRE (production service). Not assumed: UX Designer, Architect, Tech Writer, Full-path triggers. Contestable readings: F6=1 (ADR conditional on an expensive-to-reverse decision); F18=1 vs 0 (only documented per-agent processes on non-reference hosts); F21=1 (enforcement controls opt-in, default prompt-only); F24=2 rests on spec-lint --check-approval (shipped, read), not on dagger audit-export; F30 and F31 valued only from in-boundary evidence (skills/ + root instruction files) and set to 1; with cli-installer/ and .github/workflows/validate.yml counted they would be 2 each (total 64). F29 cites platforms.md inside skills/. Event-triggered mechanisms (F6 ADR, F10 debugging, F26 incident) are valued 2 when an always-dispatched agent on R must run them under a stated criterion. T1 excludes the 36 KB root CLAUDE.md (maintainer guidance not injected into R's project; largest L5 swing, about 9k tokens). L3 A3 relies on opt-in unattended mode or attended per-batch checkpoints for chaining; scripts were read, never executed.
